01 / A LITTLE ABOUT ME

An analytical mind.
A creative streak.

I’m building a career where data science meets clear communication. At IEM Kolkata, I’m deepening my skills in Python, SQL, machine learning and cloud computing. Outside the classroom, I’ve learned how to turn an idea into a story people pay attention to.

A year of taking ownership. As Public Relations Manager at NebulaPioneers, I built external communications, brand narratives and outreach strategy from the ground up. Alongside that, I managed LinkedIn content for Ureckon, UEM Kolkata’s flagship tech event, creating content for student and recruiter communities.

A creative edge, put to work. My experience at CollegeTips.in brought together content writing and graphic design with Adobe Photoshop. It’s a perspective I bring to technical work too: ask better questions, find what matters, and make it easy for someone else to understand.

Curiosity with a track record. Completed Google Cloud Foundations through LinkedIn Learning. ATL Marathon 2020: Top 10 in West Bengal and Top 300 nationally. And still learning — through hands-on projects and self-driven study.

What I’m looking for next: an internship in data science, analytics or cloud computing where I can contribute to real problems, learn from an experienced team, and bring both analytical thinking and visual storytelling to the table.
